subject.title: fix(memory-lancedb): share the recall cooldown with the auto-recall prompt-build hook

question: Can a reviewer with repository access confirm that the automatic-recall hook preserves the explicit tool’s cooldown and error-classification contract before merge?
rationale: The patch’s core design is plausible and its submitted live proof is useful, but the required direct source, history, and scoped-policy review could not run in this environment.

options.title: Verify the shared-breaker contract
options.body: Inspect the complete tool and prompt-hook paths, then merge if both paths open the cooldown only for matching embedding timeout and failure cases.

options.title: Request a narrow adjustment
options.body: Ask for a focused correction if direct review finds that a non-embedding failure can suppress automatic recall or that the agent scope differs between paths.
